author: Huawei
description:
In Kunming, Yunnan Province, China, YCIH Logistics is breaking through traditional supply chain bottlenecks and building a second revenue growth curve.
 
Transforming from a bulk material supplier into an internationally leading supply chain ecosystem operator, the company has achieved rapid revenue growth for eight consecutive years.
 
Together with #Huawei, YCIH Logistics developed the "1+N" SMART Logistics Solution to build a smarter, more efficient supply chain system, enabling standardized applications, platform-based data, intelligent operations, and visualized management across campuses.
 
Discover more: https://bit.ly/4aaYdBZ #AdvancingIndustrialAllIntelligence
title: Huawei and YCIH Logistics Set a SMART Supply Chain Benchmark
